owners  capabilities/{cap}/owners.yml  — who reviews, promotes and views a capability (one file per capability)
  codeOwners  list  required  — teams in teams/ that approve code changes (CODEOWNERS)  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:1)
    []  str  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:1)
  promoters  dict  required  — per stage name (a stage of this capability), emails that may promote into it and approve its Freight  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:2)
    *  list  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:3)
      []  str  /^[a-z0-9._%+-]+@example\.com$/  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:3)
  viewers  list  — emails with read-only access in Kargo and Argo CD  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:7)
    []  str  /^[a-z0-9._%+-]+@example\.com$/  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:7)
  breakGlass  list  — emails that may approve Freight that skipped upstream verification  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:8)
    []  str  /^[a-z0-9._%+-]+@example\.com$/  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:8)
  apps  dict  — per app name (an app of this capability) overrides; each field set replaces the capability's  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:10)
    *  map  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:11)
      codeOwners  list  — teams in teams/ that approve this app's code changes  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:12)
        []  str  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:12)
      promoters  dict  — per stage name, emails that may promote this app into it; replaces the capability's for that stage  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:14)
        *  list  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:15)
          []  str  /^[a-z0-9._%+-]+@example\.com$/  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:15)
      viewers  list  — emails with read-only access to this app  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:13)
        []  str  /^[a-z0-9._%+-]+@example\.com$/  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/owners.yml:13)

stage  capabilities/{cap}/stages/*.yml  — a stage of the capability's promotion pipeline
  dependsOn  list  — stages that must be verified before this one  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/stages/dev.yml:1)
    []  str  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/stages/perf.yml:1)
  autoPromote  bool  — promote automatically once upstream stages are verified  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/stages/dev.yml:2)
  color  str  one of red|salmon|orange|amber|yellow|lime|avocado|green|teal|cyan|sky|blue|indigo|periwinkle|violet|purple|fuchsia|pink|rose|dragonfruit|gray  — Kargo UI color for this stage's Kargo Stages; default picked per stage  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/stages/perf.yml:2)

app  capabilities/{cap}/apps/*/app.yml  — an app: what it ships and its settings at app, stage and target level
  replicas  int  — number of replicas, 0 to 100  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/my-app/app.yml:5)
  env  dict  — environment variables, KEY: value; a value may be secret:<gcp-project>/<secret>[@<version>]; merged per key  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/infra/app.yml:4)
    *  str  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/infra/app.yml:5)
  envFrom  list  — names of the target's environment-variables files to include  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:4)
    []  str  /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$/  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:4)
  resources  map  — container resource requests  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:5)
    cpu  str  /^[0-9]+m?$/  — CPU, whole cores or millicores (100m)  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:6)
    memory  str  /^[0-9]+(Mi|Gi)$/  — memory in Mi or Gi (128Mi)  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:7)
  deployWith  str  one of argocd|gha  — argocd (default) syncs the target's Argo CD app; gha dispatches a GitHub Actions workflow  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:8)
  workflow  map  — GitHub Actions workflow dispatched when deployWith is gha  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:9)
    repo  str  /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$/  — workflow repository, <owner>/<name>  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:10)
    file  str  /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.ya?ml$/  — workflow file name, .yml or .yaml  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:11)
    ref  str  /./  — git ref the workflow runs on  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/infra/app.yml:7)
  image  str  /^[a-z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]+)?(/[a-z0-9._-]+)+$/  — container image repository, no tag or digest (K8s and Cloud Run apps; set this or module)  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:2)
  imageConstraint  str  /./  — SemVer constraint for the image tags to deploy  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/my-app/app.yml:3)
  module  str  /^[a-z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]+)?(/[a-z0-9._-]+)+$/  — terraform module OCI repository, no tag or digest (terraform apps; set this or image)  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/infra/app.yml:1)
  moduleConstraint  str  /./  — SemVer constraint for the module versions to deploy  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/infra/app.yml:3)
  port  int  — container port, 1 to 65535  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/my-app/app.yml:4)
  sourceRepo  str  required  /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$/  — GitHub repository of the app's code, <owner>/<name>; pre-deploy checks run there  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:3)
  stages  dict  — stages the app deploys through, by stage name, each with its targets  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:12)
    *  map  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:13)
      replicas  int  — number of replicas, 0 to 100  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/my-app/app.yml:14)
      env  dict  — environment variables, KEY: value; a value may be secret:<gcp-project>/<secret>[@<version>]; merged per key  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/my-app/app.yml:12)
        *  str  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/my-app/app.yml:13)
      envFrom  list  — names of the target's environment-variables files to include  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/my-app/app.yml:11)
        []  str  /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$/  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/my-app/app.yml:11)
      resources  map  — container resource requests  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/my-app/app.yml:39)
        cpu  str  /^[0-9]+m?$/  — CPU, whole cores or millicores (100m)  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/my-app/app.yml:40)
        memory  str  /^[0-9]+(Mi|Gi)$/  — memory in Mi or Gi (128Mi)  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/my-app/app.yml:41)
      deployWith  str  one of argocd|gha  — argocd (default) syncs the target's Argo CD app; gha dispatches a GitHub Actions workflow  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/worker/app.yml:8)
      workflow  map  — GitHub Actions workflow dispatched when deployWith is gha  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:14)
        repo  str  /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$/  — workflow repository, <owner>/<name>  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:15)
        file  str  /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.ya?ml$/  — workflow file name, .yml or .yaml  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:16)

      targets  dict  — targets this stage deploys to, by target name; settings here override the stage's and app's  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/apps/flagged/app.yml:18)

target  capabilities/{cap}/targets/*/target.yml  — a target: where a stage deploys, reusable across apps
  config  map  required  — where a stage deploys; reusable across apps  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/dc1-dev-k8s/target.yml:1)
    platform  str  one of K8S|CLOUD_RUN|TERRAFORM  — K8S (default), TERRAFORM or CLOUD_RUN  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/dc1-dev-k8s/target.yml:9)
    environment  str  required  /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$/  — environment name, free-form (namespaces, labels)  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/dc1-dev-k8s/target.yml:4)
    environmentType  str  required  one of dev|npr|prd  — dev, npr or prd; drives policy (replicas, pre-deploy checks, cluster choice)  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/dc1-dev-k8s/target.yml:5)
    auth  map  required  — workload identity used to deploy  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/dc1-dev-k8s/target.yml:6)
      wifEmail  str  required  /^[a-z0-9-]+@[a-z0-9-]+\.iam\.gserviceaccount\.com$/  — service account email of the workload identity  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/dc1-dev-k8s/target.yml:7)
    billing  str  required  /^[a-z0-9-]+$/  — billing label for the target's cost  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/dc1-dev-k8s/target.yml:8)
    cluster  str  one of us-east4|dc1  platforms K8S  — name of the platform's cluster to deploy to; must accept the environment type  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/dc1-dev-k8s/target.yml:2)
    namespace  str  /^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$/  platforms K8S  — Kubernetes namespace  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/dc1-dev-k8s/target.yml:3)
    region  str  one of us-central1|us-east1|us-east4  platforms CLOUD_RUN,TERRAFORM  — GCP region  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/us-east4-dev-tf/target.yml:4)
    gcpProject  str  /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{4,28}[a-z0-9]$/  platforms CLOUD_RUN,TERRAFORM  — GCP project id  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/us-east4-dev-tf/target.yml:10)
    backend  map  platforms TERRAFORM  — terraform state backend  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/us-east4-dev-tf/target.yml:11)
      bucket  str  required  /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$/  — GCS bucket holding terraform state  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/us-east4-dev-tf/target.yml:12)
      prefix  str  /^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$/  — GCS object prefix for the state  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/us-east4-prd-tf/target.yml:12)

env-vars  capabilities/{cap}/targets/*/environment-variables/*.yml  — environment variables shared by apps that opt in with envFrom
  *  str  — value of the variable named by the key  (e.g. platform/render/testdata/root/capabilities/payments/targets/dc1-dev-k8s/environment-variables/launchdarkly.yml:1)
